skill.summary: Converts Markdown to styled HTML with WeChat-compatible themes. Supports code highlighting, math, PlantUML, footnotes, alerts, infographics, and optional bot...

latestVersion.changelog:

- Switched to using external dependencies for Markdown-to-HTML conversion and styling.

- No change to user-facing options or workflow; core usage remains the same.
